reconstruction_note: Rebuilt from the written splits by scripts/rebuild_clean_stats.py after the cleaning run terminated before writing clean_stats.json. All kept-side figures (document counts, characters, bytes, per-source and per-provenance breakdowns, split sizes) are exact — they are recomputed from the documents themselves. 'documents_read' is a LOWER BOUND taken from the last progress line in the run log; the true value is unknown. 'rejected_by_reason' is empty because those counters existed only in memory and were lost with the process; it is not reported as zero rejections. 'keep_rate' inherits the lower-bound caveat and is an UPPER bound on the true keep rate.
